tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Look up how well an AI agent could use a website when Botworthy last scanned it: whether it blocked agents, the score out of 100, advice, and for each of 5 everyday tasks the outcome and the exact steps (control role and accessible name) that worked. tools.name: request_scan
tools.description: Queue a website that Botworthy hasn't scanned yet. Scans run in batches by Botworthy's own agent, so expect days, not minutes; don't wait for it. Sites already scanned aren't queued again.

tools.name: report_visit
tools.description: Tell Botworthy how one of its 5 tasks went when you did it on a website. Reports aren't published: they decide what gets scanned or rescanned next. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_site · Public sink: report_visit · Destructive: request_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_site · Public sink: report_visit · Destructive: request_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
